title: Long documents, faster precedents and backup models
summary: Deep analysis for documents of any length, faster long precedents, the notetaker from your Today page, and backup AI models when one is unavailable.
body_markdown:
A round-up of everything else that shipped in late October.


## Deep analysis for long documents


Deep analysis now reviews documents of any length, PDF or Word. It works section by section, checking each part against the rest of the document. You can also send a PDF to deep analysis straight from chat.


## Large PDFs read in full


Large PDFs load completely, with page-by-page progress shown on the attachment.


## Faster long precedents


Long precedents now fill section by section, so they come back sooner.


## Send the notetaker from Today


Send the notetaker to a meeting from your Today page. Meetings already underway are joined straight away.


## Backup AI models


If one AI model is unavailable, Parachute switches to another onshore model automatically, so your work keeps moving.


## Also in this release


- **Paste files into chat.** Paste files straight into the chat box.
- **Answers that explain themselves.** If an answer fails partway, Parachute tells you why and keeps what it had written.
- **Forms in order.** Filled PDF forms now read in the right page order.
